caption: The drawing depicts a brass kettle with a rounded body and a short, curved spout, situated on a matching brass stand. The kettle features a repeating textured pattern on its body, a domed lid with a central knob, and an upward-arching handle with a black, turned wood grip that is fastened to the kettle by copper-colored metal arms. The stand beneath the kettle has four thin, gently curved legs terminating in small, claw-like feet and supports a circular platform. The overall color palette consists mainly of golden yellow and brown hues, with metallic reflections and shading that highlight the kettle’s and stand’s forms, and the background is plain and uncolored.
title: Kettle
